## Checklist

- [ ] The wording is my own. Nothing is pasted from a standard, a textbook, course notes, software documentation or a company model.
- [ ] No product names, system names or house codes.
- [ ] I ran `python3 tools/format_glossary.py`, `python3 tools/build.py`, `python3 check.py` and `node tools/test.js`.
- [ ] For a new term: one short form, a definition of one or two sentences, a "not to be confused with" note, and a worked example.
